blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-migration-1 (rename_all = "camelCase" renames every existing field of the public order JSON) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-migration-2 (Existing config.toml files without default_currency no longer load) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence:
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct OrderResponse {
    pub order_id: i64,
    pub customer_id: i64,
    pub total_cents: i64,
findings.recommendation: Remove `#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]` so `order_id`, `customer_id` and `total_cents` keep their snake_case names and only `currency` is added. Today a partner integration reading `order_id` from `GET /orders/{id}` gets nothing after this change: the JSON now holds `orderId`, `customerId`, `totalCents`. This breaks the contract in docs/api.md ("a field is never renamed or removed without two releases of deprecation"), is marked nowhere as BREAKING, is absent from the release note ("Added: Orders carry their `currency`."), and contradicts docs/api.md itself, which still lists the snake_case names. If camelCase is wanted, emit both names for two releases and announce it as BREAKING; add a test pinning the serialized field names.
findings.title: rename_all = "camelCase" renames every existing field of the public order JSON

findings.evidence:
/// The currency of orders that do not name one (ISO 4217).
pub default_currency: String,
findings.recommendation: Give the field a default (`#[serde(default = "default_currency")]` returning "EUR", the currency sold before this change) so existing files keep loading. As written, every deployed `config.toml` — which today holds only `database_url` and `listen`, as config.example.toml did on main — makes `toml::from_str` fail with a missing-field error at start-up after the upgrade, and the service does not start; nothing in the proposal or release note tells operators to add the key. Add a test loading the old two-key file. If the key must stay required, mark it BREAKING with the step to take in the release note.
findings.title: Existing config.toml files without default_currency no longer load
